exists_director:
EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((profiles p
     JOIN staff_schools ss ON ((ss.profile_id = p.id)))
     JOIN students st ON ((st.school_id = ss.school_id)))
  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (p.role = 'director'::account_role) AND (st.id = occurrences.student_id)))
